description:
The session-cost benchmark harness gains a bulk-mutation scenario so the artifact captures the post-fix bulk-update behavior.

## Background

The session-cost benchmark harness `scripts/benchmark-session-cost.sh` times a fixed set of scenarios and emits a JSON artifact at `dev/studies/perf/session-cost-<jit-commit>.json`. Once the bulk-update eligibility prefilter has bounded session opens to the work that actually needs a change, the harness adds a bulk-mutation scenario - a filtered `issue update` - recorded in the artifact's `commands` array, so the artifact measures the fixed behavior rather than the O(n)-sessions path.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `scripts/benchmark-session-cost.sh` includes a bulk-mutation scenario (a filtered `issue update`) in the scenarios it times.
- [hard] REQ-02: The emitted artifact records the bulk-mutation scenario in its `commands` array with the same per-command stat fields as the other scenarios.
- [hard] REQ-03: The bulk-mutation scenario runs against a freshly materialized fixture per measured sample so no sample observes a prior sample's mutation.

## Notes

The scenario measures the bounded bulk-update behavior, so it builds on both the benchmark harness and the eligibility-prefilter fix.
title: Bulk-mutation benchmark scenario
